content.query:
with testtbl as (
    select '1922-03-31T00:00:00.0000000' Birthdate, '+63(2)8885555' MobileNumber, 'jfmercado@chinabank.ph' EmailAddress
    union all
    select '1985-10-16T00:00:00.0000000', '+63(917)8885555','chinabank@chinabank.ph'
    union all
    select '1995-10-16T00:00:00.0000000', '+639178885555','chinabank_chinabank.ph'
    union all
    select '1995-10-16T00:00:00.0000000', NULL,NULL
)
select
 Birthdate
,LEFT(Birthdate,4) as Birthdate_Masked
,MobileNumber
,CASE WHEN MobileNumber IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE  CONCAT(SUBSTRING(MobileNumber,1,CHARINDEX(')',MobileNumber)),'*******') END as MobileNumber_Masked
,EmailAddress
,CASE WHEN EmailAddress IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN EmailAddress LIKE '%@%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(EmailAddress,CHARINDEX('@',EmailAddress),LEN(EmailAddress))) ELSE '*******' END as EmailAddress_Masked
from testtbl

select top 1000
 LEFT(CUST_DOB,4) as Birthdate_Masked
,CASE WHEN MOBILE_NUMBER IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(MOBILE_NUMBER,1,CHARINDEX(')',MOBILE_NUMBER)),'*******') END as MobileNumber_Masked
,CASE WHEN EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN EMAIL_ADDRESS LIKE '%@%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(EMAIL_ADDRESS,CHARINDEX('@',EMAIL_ADDRESS),LEN(EMAIL_ADDRESS))) ELSE '*******' END as EmailAddress_Masked
FROM eds.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST where MOBILE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL

,CASE WHEN MOBILE_NUMBER IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(MOBILE_NUMBER,1,CHARINDEX(')',MOBILE_NUMBER)),'*******') END as MobileNumber_Masked
,CASE WHEN EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN EMAIL_ADDRESS LIKE '%@%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(EMAIL_ADDRESS,CHARINDEX('@',EMAIL_ADDRESS),LEN(EMAIL_ADDRESS))) ELSE '*******' END as EmailAddress_Masked
